reviewMethod: Independent visual sweep of every page of the 2022 deferred Higher Level English question paper (LC020ALP000EV, 8 pages: cover, questions on pages 2-6, the blank page 7 and the back cover) and its deferred marking scheme (15 pages: cover, the note on deferred schemes, the general guidelines on page 3, solutions on pages 4-13, the blank page 14 and the back cover), each rendered to PNG at 1.5x and read. Each task, mark placement and part total was transcribed against the original layout, and the scheme arithmetic was re-worked line by line. June 2022 (same old syllabus and format) was the template for task boundaries, credit ladders, topics and wording. No earlier deferred cards exist, so there are no card corrections.
progressIdentityReview: No 2022 deferred Applied Mathematics cards have shipped, so no identity is retained or retired. Suffixes follow June 2022 style; the three separately priced outputs inside one printed ask use descriptive suffixes (4-a-q-r, 5-a-i-q, 5-b-i-b). The deferred card prefix must differ from June's am-2022-hl- so these suffixes cannot collide with June 2022 cards.

papers.markingGuideNote: The scheme awards attempt marks of 2. Deduct 3 for a mathematical error (blunder), or 1 for a numerical slip or a misreading that is not serious. A serious blunder, omission or misreading that oversimplifies the task receives the attempt mark only. The scheme shows one correct solution to each question; other equally valid methods are accepted.
papers.boundaryReview: Every placement in this scheme is a 5 (attempt 2). Q1(a)(iii) t = 16 and the distance 420 m receive 5 each in one task. Q3(a) the pair of angles 15° or 75° shares one final 5. Q4(a) the three equations of motion and a = (1/5)g, the acceleration of P, receive 20; the unmarked line aP = (1/5)g restates it, and the accelerations of Q and R share the final 5, so they are practised separately. Q4(b)(i) both force diagrams share one 5. Q5(a)(i) shared equations plus the speed of P receive 15; the speed of Q takes the second of the paired final placements, (5), (5). Q5(b)(i) shared equations plus v₁ for A receive 15 (the vA line carries no mark of its own); the speed of B has a separate final 5. Q6(b) is a vertical-circle question (energy plus the radial equation with T = 0). Q7(b) has five 5-mark placements, including two on the first moment equation, (5), (5). Q8(b)(i) has four 5-mark placements, including two on the moment-of-inertia expression, (5), (5). Q9(b)(i) the two buoyancy lines share one 5. Q10(b) sub-parts (i), (ii) and (iii) follow one printed lead-in, Find, and each has its own placements. No finite answer-option pools occur.
